Blast Morphology Analysis

Michael Whitehouse

2026-02-04

Survival Outcomes

  • thaw procedures in “EMBRYO TRANSFER” attempts
  • must have corresponding cryo procedure in the EMR
  • summarize by thaw protocol, day number, expansion grade, ICM grade, trophectoderm grade, biopsy count

Transfer Outcomes

  • same inclusion criteria as survival outcomes, plus those below
  • autologous euploid single embryo transfers (SETs)
  • exclude transfers too recent to have outcome data, as with KPI queries
    • include_in_bhcg_outcomes = TRUE for chemical pregnancy rate
    • include_in_sac_fh_outcomes = TRUE for clinical pregnancy rate
  • summarize by thaw protocol, day number, expansion grade, ICM grade, trophectoderm grade, biopsy count, oocyte age group, prior euploid transfer count

Load Libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(gt)
library(broom)
library(geepack)

# Source utilities (relative to this notebook's location)
kb_utils_path <- fs::path(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path), "..", "..", "kb_utils", "kb_utils.R")
source(kb_utils_path)

Load Processed Data

# Define paths
project_dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path) |> fs::path("..")
processed_dir <- fs::path(project_dir, "data", "processed")
thaws_raw <- read_latest_data(processed_dir, "blast_fet_thaws")
thaws <- thaws_raw |>
  select(oocyte_id, patient_id, lab_date, thaw_media, rapid_thaw, embryo_glue_post_thaw_recovery,
  thaw_survived, day_number, expansion, icm_grade, troph_grade, blastocyst_grade,
  pgta_euploid_embryos_transferred, embryos_transferred, embryos_thawed,
  starts_with("pgta"), total_biopsy_count,
  pgtm_tested, pgtsr_tested, clinical_results, genetic_results, sex_results,
  known_implantation, include_in_bhcg_outcomes, preg_attempt_outcome, prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers,
  oocyte_source, age_group, oocyte_age_group, age, oocyte_age,
  include_in_sac_fh_outcomes, preg_sac) |> 
  mutate(had_biopsy = (total_biopsy_count > 0),
         total_biopsy_count = replace_na(total_biopsy_count, 0),
         preg_attempt_outcome = replace_na(preg_attempt_outcome, FALSE),
         preg_sac = replace_na(preg_sac, FALSE),
         expansion = factor(
           expansion,
           levels = c("4", setdiff(sort(unique(as.character(expansion))), "4"))
         ),
         rapid_thaw = factor(rapid_thaw, 
           levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
           labels = c("Conventional Protocol", "Rapid Protocol")))

Day Number by Expansion

# Helper function to create day/expansion table
create_day_expansion_table <- function(data, title_suffix = "") {
  day_expansion <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(day_number), !is.na(expansion)) |>
    count(day_number, expansion) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = expansion, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) |>
    arrange(day_number)
  
  # Calculate row percentages (for each day, % in each expansion grade)
  expansion_cols <- setdiff(names(day_expansion), c("day_number", "Total"))
  day_expansion_with_pct <- day_expansion |>
    mutate(across(all_of(expansion_cols), 
                  ~ paste0(., " (", sprintf("%.1f%%", (. / Total) * 100), ")"),
                  .names = "{.col}"))
  
  # Add column totals
  day_expansion_with_pct <- day_expansion_with_pct |>
    mutate(day_number = as.character(day_number),
           Total = as.character(Total)) |>
    bind_rows(
      day_expansion |>
        summarise(
          day_number = "Total",
          across(where(is.numeric), sum)
        ) |>
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.character))
    )
  
  gt::gt(day_expansion_with_pct) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = paste0("Blastocyst Count by Day Number and Expansion Grade", title_suffix)) |>
    gt::cols_label(day_number = "Day Number")
}

Survival Rates

survival_group_vars <- c(
  "rapid_thaw",
  "day_number",
  "expansion",
  "icm_grade",
  "troph_grade",
  "total_biopsy_count"
)

summarize_survival_rate <- function(data, group_var) {
  df <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(thaw_survived))

  # Fit logistic regression to get p-values for each level
  p_values <- tibble(!!group_var := unique(df[[group_var]]), p_value = NA_real_)
  
  if (nrow(df) > 0 && n_distinct(df[[group_var]]) > 1) {
    tryCatch({
      model <- glm(
        as.formula(paste("thaw_survived ~ factor(", group_var, ")")),
        data = df,
        family = binomial(link = "logit")
      )
      model_summary <- broom::tidy(model)
      # Extract p-values for each level (skip intercept)
      model_summary <- model_summary |>
        filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
        mutate(
          level = stringr::str_remove(term, paste0("factor\\(", group_var, "\\)")),
          level = type.convert(level, as.is = TRUE)
        ) |>
        select(level, p_value = p.value)
      
      # Join p-values back
      p_values <- tibble(!!group_var := unique(df[[group_var]])) |>
        left_join(model_summary, by = setNames("level", group_var))
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  df |>
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) |>
    summarise(
      total_blasts_thawed = n(),
      blasts_survived = sum(thaw_survived == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      survival_rate = round(blasts_survived / total_blasts_thawed, 4),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(p_values, by = group_var) |>
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        is.na(p_value) ~ "",
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(.data[[group_var]])
}

render_survival_tables <- function(data, title_prefix) {
  for (name in survival_group_vars) {
    tbl <- summarize_survival_rate(data, name)
    cat("### ", title_prefix, " by ", gsub("_", " ", name), "\n\n", sep = "")
    
    # Create title case labels
    col_labels <- list(
      total_blasts_thawed = "Total Blasts Thawed",
      blasts_survived = "Blasts Survived",
      survival_rate = "Survival Rate",
      p_value = "p value",
      sig = ""
    )
    # Special handling for ICM
    label_text <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", name))
    label_text <- gsub("Icm", "ICM", label_text)
    col_labels[[name]] <- label_text
    
    title_text <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", name))
    title_text <- gsub("Icm", "ICM", title_text)
    
    print(
      gt::gt(tbl) |>
        gt::tab_header(
          title = paste(title_prefix, "by", title_text)
        ) |>
        gt::cols_label(.list = col_labels) |>
        gt::fmt_percent(columns = survival_rate, decimals = 1) |>
        gt::fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 4)
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

Logistic Regression for Survival Prediction

logistic_model <- glm(
  thaw_survived ~ factor(rapid_thaw) + factor(day_number) + factor(expansion) + factor(icm_grade) + factor(troph_grade),
  data = thaws,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(logistic_model)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = thaw_survived ~ factor(rapid_thaw) + factor(day_number) + 
##     factor(expansion) + factor(icm_grade) + factor(troph_grade), 
##     family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = thaws)
## 
## Coefficients:
##                                   Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## (Intercept)                       4.953679   0.214141  23.133  < 2e-16 ***
## factor(rapid_thaw)Rapid Protocol  0.339782   0.194261   1.749 0.080275 .  
## factor(day_number)6              -0.548653   0.209221  -2.622 0.008732 ** 
## factor(day_number)7               0.404191   0.743546   0.544 0.586717    
## factor(expansion)3                0.565670   0.468123   1.208 0.226902    
## factor(expansion)5               -0.550689   0.228163  -2.414 0.015797 *  
## factor(expansion)6               -0.997116   0.292619  -3.408 0.000655 ***
## factor(icm_grade)B               -0.005633   0.212023  -0.027 0.978804    
## factor(troph_grade)B             -0.239687   0.216151  -1.109 0.267478    
## factor(troph_grade)C             -0.400480   0.624659  -0.641 0.521446    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for binomial family taken to be 1)
## 
##     Null deviance: 1271.8  on 11149  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 1235.9  on 11140  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 1255.9
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 8
logistic_tidy <- broom::tidy(logistic_model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  mutate(
    term = stringr::str_replace_all(term, "factor\\(([^)]+)\\)", "\\1"),
    term = stringr::str_replace_all(term, "_", " "),
    term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(day number)(.+)$", "Day Number: \\2"),
    term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(expansion)(.+)$", "Expansion: \\2"),
    term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(icm grade)(.+)$", "ICM Grade: \\2"),
    term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(troph grade)(.+)$", "Troph Grade: \\2"),
    term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(rapid thaw)(.+)$", "Thaw: \\2"),
    term = factor(term, levels = rev(term)),
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    conf.low = round(conf.low, 3),
    conf.high = round(conf.high, 3)
  )
ggplot(logistic_tidy, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Adjusted odds ratios for thaw survival (95% CI)",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Reference: unbiopsied D5 4AA thawed by conventional protocol"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

GEE Model for Survival Prediction

# Prepare data: convert logical variables to numeric, handle NAs
# All categorical variables treated as unordered factors
thaws_gee <- thaws |>
  mutate(
    survival = as.numeric(thaw_survived),
    rapid_thaw_num = as.numeric(rapid_thaw == "Rapid Protocol"),
    day_number = factor(day_number),
    expansion = factor(expansion),
    icm_grade = factor(icm_grade),
    troph_grade = factor(troph_grade),
    total_biopsy_count = as.numeric(total_biopsy_count)
  ) |>
  select(
    patient_id,
    survival,
    rapid_thaw_num,
    day_number,
    expansion,
    icm_grade,
    troph_grade,
    total_biopsy_count
  ) |> 
  na.omit()

# Check which variables have sufficient variation
factor_vars <- c("day_number", "expansion", "icm_grade", "troph_grade")
valid_vars <- character()
for (var in factor_vars) {
  n_levels <- nlevels(thaws_gee[[var]])
  if (n_levels > 1) {
    valid_vars <- c(valid_vars, var)
  } else {
    cat("Warning: Dropping", var, "- only", n_levels, "level after na.omit()\n")
  }
}

# Also check numeric/binary predictors
if (n_distinct(thaws_gee$rapid_thaw_num) < 2) {
  cat("Warning: rapid_thaw_num has no variation\n")
}
gee_combined <- geeglm(
  survival ~ rapid_thaw_num + day_number + expansion + icm_grade + troph_grade + total_biopsy_count,
  data = thaws_gee,
  id = patient_id,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  corstr = "independence"
)

  "rapid_thaw",
  "day_number",
  "expansion",

summarize_rate <- function(data, group_var, outcome_var) {
  df <- data |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]))

  if (group_var == "oocyte_age_group") {
    level_order <- c("<35", setdiff(unique(df[[group_var]]), "<35"))
    df <- df |>
      mutate(!!group_var := factor(.data[[group_var]], levels = level_order))
  }

  # Fit logistic regression to get p-values for each level
  p_values <- tibble(!!group_var := unique(df[[group_var]]), p_value = NA_real_)
  
  if (nrow(df) > 0 && n_distinct(df[[group_var]]) > 1) {
    tryCatch({
      model <- glm(
        as.formula(paste0(outcome_var, " ~ factor(", group_var, ")")),
        data = df,
        family = binomial(link = "logit")
      )
      model_summary <- broom::tidy(model)
      # Extract p-values for each level (skip intercept)
      model_summary <- model_summary |>
        filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
        mutate(
          level = stringr::str_remove(term, paste0("factor\\(", group_var, "\\)")),
          level = type.convert(level, as.is = TRUE)
        ) |>
        select(level, p_value = p.value)
      
      # Join p-values back
      p_values <- tibble(!!group_var := unique(df[[group_var]])) |>
        left_join(model_summary, by = setNames("level", group_var))
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  df |>
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) |>
    summarise(
      total_blasts = n(),
      positive = sum(.data[[outcome_var]] == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      rate = round(positive / total_blasts, 4),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(p_values, by = group_var) |>
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        is.na(p_value) ~ "",
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(.data[[group_var]])
}

render_rate_tables <- function(data, outcome_var, title_prefix) {
  for (name in group_vars) {
    tbl <- summarize_rate(data, name, outcome_var)
    cat("### ", title_prefix, " by ", gsub("_", " ", name), "\n\n", sep = "")
    
    # Create title case labels
    col_labels <- list(
      total_blasts = "Total Blasts",
      positive = "Positive",
      rate = "Rate",
      p_value = "p value",
      sig = ""
    )
    col_labels[[name]] <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", name))
    
    print(
      gt::gt(tbl) |>
        gt::tab_header(
          title = paste(title_prefix, "by", tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", name)))
        ) |>
        gt::cols_label(.list = col_labels) |>
        gt::fmt_percent(columns = rate, decimals = 1) |>
        gt::fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 4)
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

Pregnancy Outcome Models

prep_preg_data <- function(data, outcome_var) {
  data |>
    mutate(
      outcome = as.numeric(.data[[outcome_var]]),
      rapid_thaw = factor(rapid_thaw),
      day_number = factor(day_number),
      expansion = factor(expansion),
      icm_grade = factor(icm_grade),
      troph_grade = factor(troph_grade),
      total_biopsy_count = factor(total_biopsy_count),
      prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers = factor(
        case_when(
          prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers > 3 ~ ">3",
          TRUE ~ as.character(prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers)
        ),
        levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", ">3")
      ),
      oocyte_age_group = factor(oocyte_age_group)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(outcome)) |>
    drop_na(
      patient_id,
      rapid_thaw,
      day_number,
      expansion,
      icm_grade,
      troph_grade,
      total_biopsy_count,
      prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers,
      oocyte_age_group
    )
}

fit_logistic_preg <- function(data) {
  glm(
    outcome ~ rapid_thaw + day_number + expansion + icm_grade + troph_grade + total_biopsy_count + prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers + oocyte_age_group,
    data = data,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
}

fit_gee_preg <- function(data) {
  geeglm(
    outcome ~ rapid_thaw + day_number + expansion + icm_grade + troph_grade + total_biopsy_count + prev_attempt_count_euploid_transfers + oocyte_age_group,
    data = data,
    id = patient_id,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    corstr = "independence"
  )
}

plot_forest <- function(model, title) {
  model_tidy <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
    mutate(
      term = stringr::str_replace_all(term, "factor\\(([^)]+)\\)", "\\1"),
      term = stringr::str_replace_all(term, "_", " "),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(day number)(.+)$", "Day Number: \\2"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(expansion)(.+)$", "Expansion: \\2"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(icm grade)(.+)$", "ICM Grade: \\2"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(troph grade)(.+)$", "Troph Grade: \\2"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(rapid thaw).*$", "Rapid Thaw"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(total biopsy count)(.+)$", "Biopsy Count: \\2"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(prev attempt count euploid transfers)(.+)$", "Previous Euploid Transfers: \\2"),
      term = stringr::str_replace(term, "^(oocyte age group)(.+)$", "Oocyte Age Group: \\2"),
      term = factor(term, levels = rev(term)),
      estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      conf.low = round(conf.low, 3),
      conf.high = round(conf.high, 3)
    )

  ggplot(model_tidy, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
      y = NULL,
      caption = "Reference: once-biopsied D5 4AA thawed by conventional protocol, oocyte age <35, no prior euploid transfers"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
